checks: All six styles retain the exact same table surface and visible cells on every sampled frame while delayed tab reads finish; the old table cannot be edited or saved during the switch
Each table keeps its own reading position; a first visit starts at the top and returning restores the previous scroll
Rapid A/B/CSV switching discards stale reads and keeps the latest selected file
Existing unsaved-draft confirmation still cancels navigation without losing content; explicit discard switches without writing the source
A failed target still has a real error and working retry instead of leaving old data editable under the new path
Sidebar tabs crossfade with overlapping content rather than fading out to an empty panel before the next one appears
scope: Real App, LibraryMode, WorkspaceTabs and TableView; controlled native read latency in mocked IPC. No installed performance claim.
